caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object that appears to be a hanging oil lamp or lantern, illustrated in a neutral, monochromatic scheme of greys and blacks against a plain beige background. The object consists of a rounded, flat-bottomed oil container at the base, which has a small, protruding spout on one side and an upright cylindrical cover at the center. A curved rod extends upward from the base and is attached to a vertical rod by a loop at the top of the curved section. The vertical rod is thin, tapering to a pointed tip, and contains a hook near the top. A straight wire or string runs diagonally from the vertical rod to a point on the upper surface of the container, providing structural support. The entire composition is clean and minimally detailed, with the object rendered in soft shading to convey its form and metallic texture. There are no additional objects, backgrounds, or embellishments apart from the artist's signature and date in the lower right corner.
title: Betty Lamp
